exposure: spontaneous vaginal delivery of first twin
cohort: A single patient, G3P2A0L2, with a twin pregnancy referred with obstructed labor after the spontaneous vaginal delivery of her first twin.
finding: This case report details the rare occurrence of bilateral broad ligament haematoma in a twin pregnancy complicated by obstructed labor, requiring surgical evacuation and uterine artery ligation.
mod_finding: The first twin was delivered via spontaneous vaginal delivery, and the second twin required an emergency lower segment caesarian section.
